title: Repository onboarding path
alt: Five onboarding commands run in sequence to scaffold configuration, transpile context, record debt, and verify governance.
text: Onboarding commands, in order: 1. Scaffolding (praetorctl init), 2. Context Transpilation (praetorctl compile-context), 3. Brownfield Baselining (praetorctl baseline --record --allow-increase), 4. Devcontainer Setup (praetorctl devcontainer generate), 5. Audit Verification (praetorctl audit).
Boxes: Target repository (prerequisite: AGENTS.md (or adopt)), Governed repository (praetorctl audit pass).
Target repository → 1. Scaffolding (start) → 2. Context Transpilation → 3. Brownfield Baselining → 4. Devcontainer Setup → 5. Audit Verification → Governed repository (verified).

Scenario 1, init: Initialize configuration with declared profile and facets. Target repository carries canonical AGENTS.md (greenfield repos use praetorctl adopt). Scaffolding creates .standards.yaml, .standards.lock, and initial baseline.

Scenario 2, compile-context: Transpile universal agent harness from AGENTS.md. Canonical agent instructions in AGENTS.md are compiled. Transpilation generates vendor instruction files and splices the text register.

Scenario 3, baseline: Snapshot legacy technical debt into baseline file. HISS scanner sweeps the codebase for existing infractions. Initial legacy debt is recorded with --allow-increase and --reason="<why>" to permit non-zero count.

Scenario 4, devcontainer: Prepare a portable devcontainer from reviewed Praetor sources. DevContainer configuration and reviewed source bundle companions are generated. Configuration, Dockerfile, and exact source companions are prepared in .devcontainer/.

Scenario 5, audit: Verify configured governance contracts and debt ratchet. Audit checks manifest, lockfile, agent context, debt baseline, and DevContainer. Every executed gate passes with zero files modified; repository is verified and governed.

Onboarding executes five commands in sequence to establish declarative standards, vendor agent files, baseline legacy debt, generate devcontainers, and verify compliance. Greenfield repositories use praetorctl adopt to scaffold AGENTS.md.
